description: This Java source file defines the ComponentLocationResolver class, which implements location resolution logic for components within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to resolve locations based on component configurations and handles URL and URI conversions.

classes.name: ComponentLocationResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves component-based locations into URLs, handling component-specific path logic and URL formatting.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a string location into a URL object, converting file paths to URL format.

methods.name: getBaseLocation
methods.description: Extracts and constructs the base location path for a component, handling slashes and component root location retrieval.
